header.subtitle: Renew the platforms that run the business — without a risky rip-and-replace

header.imageAlt: Modern data centre aisle with magenta accent lighting representing enterprise platform modernisation

overview.title: Service overview
overview.content: Enterprise Platform Modernisation is for organisations that need to move beyond brittle monoliths and manual operating models without pausing revenue systems. We assess what must stay, what can be decomposed, and where TenthMatrix products such as WSL Proxy and Ring Promoter shorten the path to safer change. Outcomes are owned roadmaps, reference architectures, and working increments in production — not slide decks alone.

features.title: Platform readiness assessment
features.description: Map systems, dependencies, and change risk so modernisation work targets the highest-value seams first.

features.title: Composable target architecture
features.description: Design service boundaries, APIs, and data contracts that support AI and automation without locking you into a single vendor.

features.title: Incremental cutover plans
features.description: Strangler-fig and parallel-run patterns so you modernise in controlled slices with rollback paths.

features.title: Edge and API hardening
features.description: Introduce governed gateways and promotion controls so new surfaces stay auditable as they scale.

features.title: Operating model design
features.description: Clarify ownership, SLOs, and handoffs between product, platform, and security teams.

features.title: Knowledge transfer
features.description: Runbooks, architecture decision records, and pair sessions so your team can extend the platform independently.

pricing.title: 定价
pricing.description: Discovery and architecture packages from £8,000. Multi-wave programmes priced against scope and risk.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: Workshop current-state systems, constraints, and success metrics with stakeholders and engineers.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Agree a composable target state and a sequenced backlog of safe change windows.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.description: Deliver a production increment that proves the pattern under real traffic and governance.

steps.title: Scale
steps.description: Repeat the pattern across further domains with shared tooling and promotion controls.

steps.title: Embed
steps.description: Transfer ownership with runbooks, metrics, and optional retained support.

cta.title: Plan a modernisation wave
cta.description: Share your estate and timeline — we will propose a scoped first slice, not a vague transformation programme.
